insight: GPT-OSS represents a paradigm shift by being the first open-weight model designed with tool use in mind.
why_it_matters: This capability could significantly reduce common issues like hallucinations by enabling real-time data retrieval.
evidence_quote: GPT-oss... is kind of like the first public or like open weight model that was really trained with tool use in mind.

insight: The ability to call external tools like web searches or calculators could address LLM hallucinations effectively.
why_it_matters: This approach can enhance the reliability of LLM outputs, making them more useful in practical applications.
evidence_quote: one of the best ways to solve hallucinations is to not try to always remember information or make things up.

insight: Open-source models allow users to run AI locally, addressing privacy concerns associated with cloud-based solutions.
